PullRequest.Title: Fix flaky test in modelConfigPicker by adjusting click behavior

Scenarios.Scenario: Smoke-test automation opens the chat model configuration details picker, including retrying after a partially completed prior attempt.
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The test cannot inspect or select model settings until the Playwright locator checks and, when closed, the click plus visible-state wait complete. The added visibility/expanded-state guard is on this test critical path.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Playwright queries locator visibility and conditionally reads aria-expanded in the browser process.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One isVisible command per loop attempt and one getAttribute command only when a visible radio group exists; attempts are serialized and deadline-bounded.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Each attempt immediately waited for and clicked the readout, even if details were already open; no state-query commands preceded the click.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Adds one immediate browser automation round trip when the picker is closed, but when already open it avoids the prior toggle-close, five-second visibility wait, Escape recovery, and retry.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Playwright waits for the readout, clicks it, waits for the radio group, and may press Escape on failure.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: At most one serialized sequence per retry attempt, bounded by timeoutMs; the diff can skip this existing sequence for an already-open picker.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same wait/click/wait/recovery sequence ran unconditionally on every attempt.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Required to open a closed picker; failure waits can delay the test, but the new guard reduces rather than increases this path when state is already open.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: One helper invocation per picker open: one defaults inspection plus one open for each of three configuration cases in the current smoke suite. Retry count is bounded by the caller's 30-second deadline rather than by model-option cardinality.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: All locator checks, click, wait, Escape recovery, and retry delay are awaited serially; there is no fan-out or concurrent browser-command burst.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No cache is used or needed. The guard reads current DOM state on every attempt because picker state can change between attempts; a warm/already-open picker exits after two checks, while a closed picker adds one immediate visibility check before the existing path.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the changed lines and Playwright await ordering directly establish the serialized IPC calls and bounded retry behavior.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Browser-command round-trip duration varies by CI load, but cardinality is small and fixed. The only added cost on a normally closed picker is one visibility query; the changed warm-state path removes a substantially longer failed retry.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The added bounded state checks prevent repeated close/reopen work and add only one lightweight browser query on the normal closed-picker path.

Scenarios.Scenario: Smoke-test automation selects model configuration radio options and waits for the configuration readout to confirm the asynchronous save.
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The option visibility wait, click, and readout confirmation must finish before the test can close the picker and send the mock-model request. The diff changes only the maximum duration of the existing click command.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Playwright sends the radio-option click to the browser process.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One click per serialized attempt, with retries bounded by timeoutMs; the configured click timeout is now explicitly capped at five seconds.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same click occurred with Playwright's inherited/default timeout rather than an explicit five-second cap.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The click remains on the selection critical path. The new timeout can shorten a blocked attempt and permit recovery sooner; it does not add an operation.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Playwright evaluates the readout confirmation in the page and may invoke the existing reopen sequence after failure.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One confirmation evaluation per click attempt and at most one serialized reopen after each failed attempt, all bounded by the outer deadline.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same confirmation and retry/reopen behavior existed before the timeout argument changed.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Confirms the asynchronous configuration save before progress. Its placement and frequency are unchanged by this diff.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Five option selections across the three current configuration cases (three context selections and two effort selections). Retry attempts are serialized and bounded by a 30-second outer deadline.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: One option is selected at a time. Playwright commands and any reopen retry are awaited serially; no Promise.all, queue burst, or per-option concurrent work is introduced.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No cache participates. Each selection intentionally waits for the authoritative readout after the configuration write; retries reopen current UI state rather than using cached state.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the diff only adds a timeout option to an existing awaited click; surrounding code proves unchanged serialized confirmation and retry behavior.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: The inherited pre-diff Playwright timeout is not established here, but the change introduces no extra work or concurrency and explicitly bounds the existing click at five seconds.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The timeout bounds existing IPC wait latency and neither increases operation cardinality nor adds retained resources.

Analysis.Summary: Completed the performance pass over the sole changed file and both affected smoke-test workflows. The diff adds a bounded DOM-state guard that avoids failed toggle/retry work and caps an existing click wait; no actionable performance regression was introduced.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
